about: Every minigame and feature that can reach a player. status 'live' = reachable from abbies.world and it has BOTH a real scene in the world (scene.gates are keys of ENTRANCES in simulations/abbietown/entrances.mjs, each with a scene id) AND a passing automated end-to-end run in headless Chrome (test). Anything else is 'experimental': it stays out of the live town and opens only with ?exp=<id> or in developer mode (simulations/experimental.mjs). Rules and checks: tools/game-registry/README.md. Evan, 2026-10-24.
